title: Tamsin and the Garden
author: Marguerite Hartwell
blurb: Tamsin Almeida, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
